# LoopWhichDoesNotLoop

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `LoopWhichDoesNotLoopInspection`

A loop whose body always leaves on the first pass (its last statement is
`break`, `return` or `throw` and nothing continues it), or whose body is
empty, never actually iterates. It is either a bug or a disguised `if` /
"take first element" idiom.

## Example

```php{2,6,9,12,15,18}
<?php
foreach ($queue as $job) {
    process($job);
    break;
}
for ($t = 0; $t < 5; $t++) {
    return $t;
}
while (poll()) {
    throw new \LogicException('stop');
}
do {
    break 1;
} while ($again);
while (wait()) {
    // nothing yet
}
foreach ($grid as $line) {
    foreach ($line as $cell) {
        while (true) {
            continue 2;        // continues the middle loop, not the outer one
        }
    }
    break;
}

foreach ($grid as $line) {
    foreach ($line as $cell) {
        continue 2;            // continues the outer loop
    }
    break;
}
foreach ($grid as $line) {
    if (!$line) { continue; }
    break;
}
while ($ok) {
    step();
}
/** @var \Iterator $cursor */
foreach ($cursor as $first) {
    break;
}
while ($ok) break;
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Loop body exits on the first iteration; the loop never repeats.</li>
<li>line 6: Loop body exits on the first iteration; the loop never repeats.</li>
<li>line 9: Loop body exits on the first iteration; the loop never repeats.</li>
<li>line 12: Loop body exits on the first iteration; the loop never repeats.</li>
<li>line 15: Loop body exits on the first iteration; the loop never repeats.</li>
<li>line 18: Loop body exits on the first iteration; the loop never repeats.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "LoopWhichDoesNotLoop": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore LoopWhichDoesNotLoop

/**
 * @noinspection LoopWhichDoesNotLoopInspection
 */
```
